nodes.description: Public mapping of token balances; mutated in transferFrom, batchSend and _mints.
Nested mapping of allowances; written in approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Private privileged address set to msg.sender in the constructor and gate for init/batchSend/delegate/setTradeAddress.
Per-address counter of sales, incremented in transferFrom and checked in condition.
Whitelist mapping set in _mints and checked in ensure to bypass sale limits.
Maximum number of sales allowed per address, configured in init.
Whitelisted trade address set by owner in setTradeAddress and honored in ensure.
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 Router address permanently whitelisted inside ensure.
Public payable token transfer that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as sender.
Internal view authorization check consulting owner, UNI, tradeAddress, canSale and condition.
Public payable core transfer path: spends allowance, calls ensure, and rewrites balanceOf/_onSaleNum.
Public payable allowance setter writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit predicate using _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale, _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing arbitrary delegatecall to a user supplied address and payload.
Privileged mint hook writing balanceOf[spender] and canSale[spender].
Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only loop that multiplies _value by the array length and credits many recipients.
Owner-only setter of the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation from factory and token pair.
Payable constructor minting total supply to msg.sender and granting infinite UNI allowance.
Private library helper performing a low-level call to a token and decoding optional return data.
Caller controlled address used for ownership gates, allowance ownership and sender identity.
Arbitrary delegatecall into the address/calldata supplied by the owner.
Overflow-prone multiplication and subtractions done without SafeMath in batchSend.
Library low-level call that forwards encoded ERC20 calldata and can execute arbitrary token code.
Debited account supplied to transferFrom.
Credited account supplied to transferFrom.
Transfer amount checked against allowance and balance.
Spender address receiving the allowance.
Target contract address of the owner-initiated delegatecall.
Raw calldata forwarded to the delegatecall target.
Array of recipient addresses iterated in batchSend.
Mint amount scaling balanceOf[spender] in _mints.
New trade address stored in the whitelist slot.
Number of permitted sales per address.
Minimum sale amount denominated in whole tokens.
Maximum sale amount denominated in whole tokens.
Token name stored in the public name slot.
Token symbol stored in the public symbol slot.
Initial supply scaled by 10**decimals into totalSupply.
Local aggregate _value * _tos.length computed without SafeMath.
Loop index over the _tos array in batchSend.
Derived Uniswap pair address for this token compared against _from.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against _from and is debited from allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender], caller identity controls the allowance owner.
require(msg.sender == owner) is the sole guard before an arbitrary delegatecall.
_mints requires msg.sender to be owner or a hardcoded privileged address.
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass balance writes.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before mutating the whitelist.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and receives the whole supply.
Owner supplied address a and payload b flow directly into an unconstrained delegatecall.
_value * _tos.length and the following balance subtractions are performed without SafeMath.
callOptionalReturn forwards ABI-encoded token calldata into a raw low-level call.
transferFrom subtracts from balanceOf[_from] and adds to balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] when the caller is not the sender.
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) to authorize the transfer.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after every transfer.
ensure falls back to condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted senders.
canSale[_from] whitelisting bypasses all sale limit checks inside ensure.
Constant UNI router address is treated as an always-authorized sender.
tradeAddress whitelisting lets an owner-set address bypass condition checks.
condition compares _saleNum against the per-address counter.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale cap.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
batchSend loops crediting balanceOf[_to] for every recipient address.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue scaled by decimals.
Parameter _from is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter _to is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter _value carries the amount through allowance and balance updates.
Parameter _spender indexes the allowance mapping written by approve.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target inside delegate.
Parameter b is the raw calldata passed to delegatecall.
Parameter _tos is the recipient array iterated by batchSend.
Parameter addedValue determines the minted balance in _mints.
Parameter addr is stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
Parameter saleNum configures _saleNum in init.
Parameter token configures _minSale in init.
Parameter maxToken configures _maxSale in init.
Parameter _name is written to the public name slot in the constructor.
Parameter _symbol is written to the public symbol slot in the constructor.
Parameter _supply is scaled by 10**decimals into totalSupply.
Local total stores the overflow-prone product of _value and _tos.length.
Loop index i drives the batchSend recipient iteration.
Local _UNI holds the derived pair address compared against _from in ensure.
Attacker-controlled delegatecall code can re-enter transferFrom and manipulate balanceOf/allowance state.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from is only meaningful as the debited account of transferFrom.
Parameter _to is only meaningful as the credited account of transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the transfer amount consumed by transferFrom.
Parameter _spender only indexes the allowance mapping written by approve.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target used solely inside delegate.
Parameter b is the calldata payload used solely inside delegate.
Parameter _tos is the recipient array iterated exclusively by batchSend.
Parameter addedValue only scales the balance written by _mints.
Parameter addr is only stored by setTradeAddress.
Parameter saleNum only configures _saleNum inside init.
Parameter token only configures _minSale inside init.
Parameter maxToken only configures _maxSale inside init.
Parameter _name is only assigned to the name state variable in the constructor.
Parameter _symbol is only assigned to the symbol state variable in the constructor.
Parameter _supply is only scaled into totalSupply in the constructor.
Local total materializes the overflow-prone multiplication flagged as an unsafe operation.
Loop index i exists only to drive the batchSend iteration.
Local _UNI exists only as the derived pair comparison inside ensure.
